rv.q: There is more than a touch of genius on display in the American Blues Theater’s production of “Stand Up If You’re Here Tonight.”
You must see 'Stand Up If You're Here Tonight.'
It’s a refreshing piece of theatre that’s creative, unique and an evening that audiences will never forget.
The clever script crackles with timely wit, and a masterly comic, Jim Ortlieb , has the audience in the palm of his hand.
Ortlieb's 'Stand Up If You're Here Tonight' pokes fun at everyday life, which will cause laughter and free you from the scrutiny of life.
Stand Up If You’re Here Tonight is at its best when it shows its hand as a messy, earnest, poetic dalliance...
The show loses its way by final curtain, and what had been bracing and provocative begins to seem mushy and manipulative.
If you're looking for a thought-provoking piece that is made to be experienced in person, this would be a good fit for you.
Fifty-Five wonderful minutes of interplay with us.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate, timely comedy as a brilliant post-pandemic meditation on connection, with Jim Ortlieb delivering a masterly performance that keeps audiences laughing and engaged throughout the clever, empathetic one-man show.
